# Thi thu voi JupyterLab that

1. Giai nen ZIP thanh thu muc rieng cho de nay. Khong giai nen de len bai lam cu.
2. Tren Windows: cai Python 3.10+ neu chua co, mo `Mo-JupyterLab.cmd`.
   Tren macOS/Linux: mo Terminal tai thu muc de va chay `python3 start-jupyterlab.py`.
3. Lan dau launcher cai thu vien vao moi truong rieng neu Python hien tai chua du thu vien. Can Internet va dung luong dia cho buoc nay; cac de sau dung lai moi truong do.
4. Trinh duyet mo JupyterLab tai localhost. Mo description.md de doc de, notebook.ipynb de lam bai. Shift+Enter chay o; Ctrl+S luu vao thu muc nay. Cac file data/ dung duong dan tuong doi nhu trong de thi.
5. Xuat submission.csv theo description.md. Dong Jupyter server bang Ctrl+C o cua so launcher khi hoc xong.

Launcher khong ghi de notebook, dataset hay bai lam. Python chay tren may ban voi quyen cua tai khoan he dieu hanh; root_dir chi la thu muc hien thi, khong phai sandbox. Khong chia se token Jupyter va khong mo server nay bang Tunnel cho nguoi khac.

JupyterLab luu bai tren dia, khong tu dong bo voi website. Ban co the dung nut Sao luu notebook o website de tai notebook da luu len tai khoan; tai ZIP bai cloud tren may khac de tiep tuc. Dau ra notebook se bi bo khi sao luu cloud. Chat AI va bai lam web cu van co lien ket rieng tren website.

Neu bi loi pip: kiem tra Internet va Python 3.10+, mo lai launcher. Neu da co moi truong thi rieng, kich hoat moi truong do roi chay `python start-jupyterlab.py --use-current`. Khong can cai model AI de dung JupyterLab.
